headline_question: Now that the Lab can deterministically explain its architecture, dependencies, impact and historical causal evidence, what most improves the next self-change cycle?
top_recommendation: Context Compiler on top of the Architectural Twin

proposals.title: Context Compiler on top of the Architectural Twin
proposals.evidence: Gen7 achieved dependency and change-impact precision/recall of 1.0/1.0 with zero measured FP/FN, median bounded query latency 1.586 ms, and a 7,466-byte architecture packet versus a 2,166,931-byte broad authoritative-input proxy (99.66% reduction). The Twin now supplies exactly the grounded dependency, authority, freshness, regression and recovery information a bounded context compiler needs.
proposals.expected_benefit: Compile task-specific, freshness-checked context packets from Twin + procedural memory + regressions while always retaining mandatory containment/authority invariants. Reduce broad repository rereading without weakening fail-closed validation.

proposals.title: Reproducible Experiment Capsule + Evaluator / Mutation Nursery
proposals.evidence: Gen7 found two concrete experiment-isolation failures: the legacy Gen5 benchmark mutated the populated live Forge registry when run directly, and the retained Gen4 lifecycle benchmark rewound real /etc/optiplex-lab/build.json metadata despite cloned workflow/graph registries. Both were detected and reconciled, but they show that benchmark isolation is not yet systemic.
proposals.expected_benefit: Run benchmark descendants, evaluator mutants and lifecycle experiments inside disposable version-pinned state capsules with explicit writable-resource declarations and post-run mutation assertions. Then use bounded mutants/adversarial cases to measure evaluator discrimination before promotion.

proposals.title: Counterfactual Replay
proposals.evidence: Gen7 reconstructed explicit real historical chains including timeout capability -> generated regression and bad candidate -> auto rollback -> restored LKG with confidence-1 causal links. The remaining causal-minimality question is what would have happened if one artifact/evaluator/version differed.
proposals.expected_benefit: Replay selected historical episodes in disposable capsules, vary one version at a time, report replay fidelity explicitly, and strengthen failure attribution/regression synthesis without treating temporal correlation as causation.

proposals.title: Capability Consolidator with semantic lineage
proposals.evidence: The accepted Twin currently models 14 capabilities and durable lineage, while Gen6 already supports memory supersession/retirement. Growth is visible but not yet the dominant measured bottleneck.
proposals.expected_benefit: Detect near-equivalent capabilities/memories, consolidate only after replaying attached evaluators/regressions, and preserve immutable ancestry/rollback references.

proposals.title: Targeted Causal Span Enrichment
proposals.evidence: Gen7 required only one inferred architecture edge out of 224 and successfully reconstructed the required historical causal paths from existing IDs/hashes. Broad instrumentation is therefore not justified yet.
proposals.expected_benefit: Add parent/correlation IDs only at empirically demonstrated causal gaps, keeping raw evidence compact and avoiding a server-wide tracing rewrite.

roadmap_assessment: Gen7 materially changes the ordering of the roadmap. The Context Compiler is now the strongest next step because its prerequisite grounded self-model exists and measured context reduction is large. Experiment isolation/evaluator mutation rises to second because Gen7 exposed real retained-benchmark state leakage. Counterfactual Replay becomes credible but should build on disposable experiment capsules rather than precede them.
